kibana.query:
TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_cpu_seconds_total IS NOT NULL
| STATS node_cpu_seconds_total_A_lhs = SUM(CASE((labels.mode == "system"), IRATE(metrics.node_cpu_seconds_total), NULL)), node_cpu_seconds_total_A_rhs = COUNT_DISTINCT(labels.cpu), node_cpu_seconds_total_B_lhs = SUM(CASE((labels.mode == "user"), IRATE(metrics.node_cpu_seconds_total), NULL)), node_cpu_seconds_total_B_rhs = COUNT_DISTINCT(labels.cpu), node_cpu_seconds_total_C_lhs = SUM(CASE((labels.mode == "iowait"), IRATE(metrics.node_cpu_seconds_total), NULL)), node_cpu_seconds_total_C_rhs = COUNT_DISTINCT(labels.cpu), node_cpu_seconds_total_D_lhs = SUM(CASE((labels.mode RLIKE ".*irq"), IRATE(metrics.node_cpu_seconds_total), NULL)), node_cpu_seconds_total_D_rhs = COUNT_DISTINCT(labels.cpu), node_cpu_seconds_total_E_lhs = SUM(CASE(((labels.mode != "idle" OR (labels.mode IS NULL AND "" != "idle"))) and ((labels.mode != "user" OR (labels.mode IS NULL AND "" != "user"))) and ((labels.mode != "system" OR (labels.mode IS NULL AND "" != "system"))) and ((labels.mode != "iowait" OR (labels.mode IS NULL AND "" != "iowait"))) and ((labels.mode != "irq" OR (labels.mode IS NULL AND "" != "irq"))) and ((labels.mode != "softirq" OR (labels.mode IS NULL AND "" != "softirq"))), IRATE(metrics.node_cpu_seconds_total), NULL)), node_cpu_seconds_total_E_rhs = COUNT_DISTINCT(labels.cpu), node_cpu_seconds_total_F_lhs = SUM(CASE((labels.mode == "idle"), IRATE(metrics.node_cpu_seconds_total), NULL)), node_cpu_seconds_total_F_rhs = COUNT_DISTINCT(labels.cpu) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| EVAL Busy_System = (node_cpu_seconds_total_A_lhs / node_cpu_seconds_total_A_rhs)
| EVAL Busy_User = (node_cpu_seconds_total_B_lhs / node_cpu_seconds_total_B_rhs)
| EVAL Busy_Iowait = (node_cpu_seconds_total_C_lhs / node_cpu_seconds_total_C_rhs)
| EVAL Busy_IRQs = (node_cpu_seconds_total_D_lhs / node_cpu_seconds_total_D_rhs)
| EVAL Busy_Other = (node_cpu_seconds_total_E_lhs / node_cpu_seconds_total_E_rhs)
| EVAL Idle = (node_cpu_seconds_total_F_lhs / node_cpu_seconds_total_F_rhs)
| EVAL __labels_ab = MV_APPEND("Busy System", "Busy User"), __labels_cd = MV_APPEND("Busy Iowait", "Busy IRQs")
| EVAL __labels = MV_APPEND(MV_APPEND(__labels_ab, __labels_cd), MV_APPEND("Busy Other", "Idle"))
| EVAL __values_ab = MV_APPEND(COALESCE(TO_STRING(Busy_System), ""), COALESCE(TO_STRING(Busy_User), "")), __values_cd = MV_APPEND(COALESCE(TO_STRING(Busy_Iowait), ""), COALESCE(TO_STRING(Busy_IRQs), ""))
| EVAL __values = MV_APPEND(MV_APPEND(__values_ab, __values_cd), MV_APPEND(COALESCE(TO_STRING(Busy_Other), ""), COALESCE(TO_STRING(Idle), "")))
| EVAL __pairs = MV_ZIP(__labels, __values, "~")
| MV_EXPAND __pairs
| EVAL series_group = MV_FIRST(SPLIT(__pairs, "~")), value = TO_DOUBLE(MV_LAST(SPLIT(__pairs, "~")))
| KEEP time_bucket, series_group, value
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_memory_MemTotal_bytes IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_memory_Cached_bytes IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_memory_Buffers_bytes IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_memory_SReclaimable_bytes IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_memory_MemFree_bytes IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_memory_SwapTotal_bytes IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_memory_SwapFree_bytes IS NOT NULL
| STATS RAM_Total = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_memory_MemTotal_bytes)), node_memory_Cached_bytes_B_rhs_lhs_lhs = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_memory_Cached_bytes)), node_memory_Buffers_bytes_B_rhs_lhs_rhs = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_memory_Buffers_bytes)), node_memory_SReclaimable_bytes_B_rhs_rhs = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_memory_SReclaimable_bytes)), node_memory_Cached_bytes_C_lhs_lhs = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_memory_Cached_bytes)), node_memory_Buffers_bytes_C_lhs_rhs = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_memory_Buffers_bytes)), node_memory_SReclaimable_bytes_C_rhs = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_memory_SReclaimable_bytes)), RAM_Free = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_memory_MemFree_bytes)), node_memory_SwapTotal_bytes_E_lhs = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_memory_SwapTotal_bytes)), node_memory_SwapFree_bytes_E_rhs = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_memory_SwapFree_bytes)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.instance, labels.job
| EVAL RAM_Used = ((RAM_Total - RAM_Free) - ((node_memory_Cached_bytes_B_rhs_lhs_lhs + node_memory_Buffers_bytes_B_rhs_lhs_rhs) + node_memory_SReclaimable_bytes_B_rhs_rhs))
| EVAL RAM_Cache_Buffer = ((node_memory_Cached_bytes_C_lhs_lhs + node_memory_Buffers_bytes_C_lhs_rhs) + node_memory_SReclaimable_bytes_C_rhs)
| EVAL SWAP_Used = (node_memory_SwapTotal_bytes_E_lhs - node_memory_SwapFree_bytes_E_rhs)
| EVAL __labels_ab = MV_APPEND("RAM Used", "RAM Cache + Buffer"), __labels_cd = MV_APPEND("RAM Free", "SWAP Used")
| EVAL __labels = MV_APPEND(__labels_ab, __labels_cd)
| EVAL __values_ab = MV_APPEND(COALESCE(TO_STRING(RAM_Used), ""), COALESCE(TO_STRING(RAM_Cache_Buffer), "")), __values_cd = MV_APPEND(COALESCE(TO_STRING(RAM_Free), ""), COALESCE(TO_STRING(SWAP_Used), ""))
| EVAL __values = MV_APPEND(__values_ab, __values_cd)
| EVAL __pairs = MV_ZIP(__labels, __values, "~")
| MV_EXPAND __pairs
| EVAL metric_label = MV_FIRST(SPLIT(__pairs, "~")), value = TO_DOUBLE(MV_LAST(SPLIT(__pairs, "~")))
| EVAL series_group = metric_label
| KEEP time_bucket, series_group, value
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_network_receive_bytes_total IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_network_transmit_bytes_total IS NOT NULL
| STATS recv = AVG(IRATE(metrics.node_network_receive_bytes_total)), trans = AVG(IRATE(metrics.node_network_transmit_bytes_total)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.device
| EVAL recv = (recv * 8)
| EVAL trans = (-1 * (trans * 8))
| EVAL __labels = MV_APPEND("Receive", "Transmit"), __values = MV_APPEND(COALESCE(TO_STRING(recv), ""), COALESCE(TO_STRING(trans), ""))
| EVAL __pairs = MV_ZIP(__labels, __values, "~")
| MV_EXPAND __pairs
| EVAL direction = MV_FIRST(SPLIT(__pairs, "~")), value = TO_DOUBLE(MV_LAST(SPLIT(__pairs, "~")))
| EVAL series_group = CONCAT(COALESCE(TO_STRING(`labels.device`), ""), " / ", direction)
| KEEP time_bucket, series_group, value
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE (NOT (labels.device RLIKE "rootfs") OR (labels.device IS NULL AND NOT ("" RLIKE "rootfs")))
| WHERE metrics.node_filesystem_avail_bytes IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_filesystem_size_bytes IS NOT NULL
| STATS node_filesystem_avail_bytes_device_rootfs = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_filesystem_avail_bytes)), node_filesystem_size_bytes_device_rootfs = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_filesystem_size_bytes)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.mountpoint
| EVAL value = (100 - ((node_filesystem_avail_bytes_device_rootfs * 100) / node_filesystem_size_bytes_device_rootfs))
| EVAL series_group = COALESCE(TO_STRING(`labels.mountpoint`), "")
| KEEP time_bucket, series_group, value
| SORT time_bucket ASC
